We need to construct a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). Need to pick one that can go through subsequent templates.

The result of 29646 gave three tuples: each tuple seems to be a precursor SMILES? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)',))"

So three possible precursors. Need to choose a path that matches subsequent templates.

We have applied 1914389 to first precursor (with Si protecting group) gave two precursors: one is "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and other "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". That seems like a disconnection: maybe the template splits off a protecting group? Actually 1914389 seems to be a protecting group removal? Not sure.

We then applied 1914390 to the first of those (the one with Si) and got a product "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". That seems like a further transformation.

Now we need to apply template 149040 to something, then 1914391.

We need to ensure each step matches.

We have not yet applied 149040 to any molecule. We tried checking matching for "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1" and got False. So maybe need a different branch.

Maybe we should choose a different precursor from 29646 that leads to a path where 149040 applies.

Let's examine the second precursor from 29646: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". This has Si protecting group on carboxylate. We applied 1914389 to that earlier and got no result. So maybe not.

Third precursor: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)". This is a simpler molecule lacking protecting groups. Let's try applying 1914389 to that.
